title: Customer pages drawn by the theme
problem: The store had no home page, cart page or search, and offers and checkout pages had their own fixed header.
now: A store home, cart, search and page-not-found page join product, category, page, offers, checkout and the order-link page, all with the theme's header, footer and colours.
steps: Open /store and add a phone to the cart from a card
The side cart opens with the free delivery bar; press Checkout
The checkout shows the same items
Search for charger from the header
notes: Where: Customer pages: /store, /cart, /search?q=, /product, /category, /page, /offers, /checkout · Needs the server: Customer accounts, wishlist and compare are not built yet; those buttons say so.
